note: Drafts: every spot goes to Pipeline C research (hours, cost, official site) before it is applied. LOW pins are provisional and flagged in needs_research; null coordinates mean no source feature was found.

proposed_new_destinations.name: Tasman Peninsula
proposed_new_destinations.coordinates_source: midpoint of its kept spots (Port Arthur, Eaglehawk Neck, Coal Mines, Cape Raoul, Cape Hauy); to be re-set from a named visitor hub in research
proposed_new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage region page 'Tasman Peninsula' (en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Tasman_Peninsula); Discover Tasmania region page 'Tasman Peninsula' (hobart-and-south/tasman-peninsula); Port Arthur Wikivoyage page.
proposed_new_destinations.why: Named region travellers use (Port Arthur, the capes and the Eaglehawk Neck coast); 15 kept spots. Named for the region rather than Tasman National Park or Port Arthur so the park, the site and the coast sit in one destination (no overlapping destinations).

proposed_new_destinations.name: Freycinet
proposed_new_destinations.coordinates_source: Wikipedia 'Freycinet National Park' coordinates; confirm a visitor-hub point in research
proposed_new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage 'Freycinet National Park'; Parks Tasmania 'Freycinet National Park'; Discover Tasmania east-coast 'Freycinet National Park' (three counted sources). Named 'Freycinet' (the national park destination); Freycinet National Park itself is the destination and not also a spot.
proposed_new_destinations.why: Flagship park (Wineglass Bay) and 6 kept spots; Coles Bay is the gateway town and is not a spot (service town, review).

proposed_new_destinations.name: Bicheno
proposed_new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage page 'Bicheno'; Discover Tasmania east-coast 'Bicheno' page.
proposed_new_destinations.why: Town with its own Wikivoyage page and Discover Tasmania chapter; five kept spots (Gulch, Blowhole, Natureworld, Douglas-Apsley, Apsley Waterhole). The town is the destination, not a spot of itself. Freycinet is 28 km south: Bicheno is a separate base on the Great Eastern Drive; Friendly Beaches (between them) sits in Freycinet National Park.

neighbour_check: Maria Island spots (standalone) are 60+ km from Freycinet and 75 km from the Tasman Peninsula centre: not spots of either.
Spring Beach (standalone) is 58 km from the Tasman Peninsula centre and 55 km from Freycinet: no proposed destination within 40 km.
Swansea (Freycinet spot) is 30 km from Bicheno but outside Bicheno's 26 km reach; it is closer to and used with Freycinet.
Richmond (standalone): 55 km from the Tasman Peninsula centre; Coal Mines is 37 km from Richmond but visitors reach Richmond from Hobart, not the peninsula.
Oatlands, Ross, Ross Bridge (standalone): 100+ km from every proposed destination here.
Friendly Beaches: 15 km from both Bicheno and Freycinet centres; placed in Freycinet because it lies in Freycinet National Park and is reached by the Coles Bay road side.

spots.name: Port Arthur Historic Site
spots.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=attraction (Photon) 'Port Arthur Historic Site'; Commons geotag median 210 m away
spots.reason: Core headline attraction of the Tasman Peninsula, inside the span, 10 km from the proposed centre.
spots.bio: World Heritage convict penitentiary and village ruins at the head of the Tasman Peninsula, the area's main attraction.
